name: dhcp-strict-dhcpv4-semantic-validation
instr:
Add opt-in semantic validation for DHCPv4 values, packets, transport conversations, and netboot configuration while preserving existing permissive behavior. Callers receive complete, deterministic diagnostics before invalid data becomes observable. Validated packet modification is transactional.

Validation reports are immutable, repeatable, and ordered by packet field then numeric option code, with stable paths, codes, severities, and descriptive messages. Every supported option representation, including AutoConfiguration, Duration, IP, IPs, Uint16, OptionCodeList, and OptionGeneric, enforces its code-sensitive wire and contextual semantics without changing serialization, formatting, caller ordering, or permissive handling. Stored Options use concrete decoders, continue after decoding failures, and aggregate every issue deterministically. DHCPv4 packet validation combines header, required-option, option-value, and cross-option diagnostics without mutating packet data. Strict parsing succeeds only when framing and semantics are valid, whereas FromBytes remains semantically permissive. ApplyValidated applies modifiers in caller order but publishes no changes unless the final packet validates. One ValidationPolicy produces matching classifications at validated client, server, and netboot boundaries; invalid client conversations retain prior replies, invalid server datagrams suppress only their handler call, and invalid netboot replies never produce configuration.
